scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight on a two-lane road while an adversarial car in the opposite lane drifts across the double yellow line into the ego's path.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane.

adversarials.behavior: The car drifts left across the double yellow center line and enters the oncoming lane in front of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a two-lane road with double yellow center lines, the ego vehicle travels in one lane while an adversarial car in the opposite lane crosses into the ego's lane from the left.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario terminates once the ego vehicle reacts to or passes the encroaching adversarial vehicle.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the centered car in the right lane; the adversarial is the car in the left lane. 2. Chronology: Initially both travel opposite directions; midpoint adversarial drifts across center line; ending it blocks ego's path. 3. Evidence: Arrow shows adversarial's leftward trajectory crossing into ego lane; double yellow lines confirm opposite traffic flow.
